Do not substitute a native answer literal, an unguarded local result or a fallback. Python lists/dictionaries and min/max are supported. All branches must type check. Exact division uses an integer denominator; monetary results must remain exact. The runtime contract lists actual typed-input constructors, the seven connector operators, their parameter shapes and output projections. Use explicit learned(pattern=...,variant=...,slots=...,columns=...) calls only when an available graph matches current witness/quantity obligations.
